account.title: Account
account.guestBody: This profile lives on this device only. Attach Google or an email and it follows you anywhere.
account.signOutGuestWarning: Signing out of a guest profile loses it for good — there is no way back in.
account.signOutBody: You will land on a fresh guest profile. This account keeps everything and opens again on the next sign-in.
account.telegramHint: Attach an email to this Telegram profile and the same account opens on the web.
account.telegramGoogleHint: Google needs a real browser window. The button opens Cast Adrift outside Telegram.

merge.title: Two profiles, one account
merge.body: Both sides carry progress. Pick the one to keep — the other is archived, never deleted.

error.popupBlocked: The browser blocked the sign-in window. Allow pop-ups and try again.
error.network: No connection to the server. Progress stays on this device until it is back.
error.invalidEmail: That does not look like an email address.
error.weakPassword: Pick a password of at least 6 characters.
error.emailInUse: That email already has an account. Sign in instead.
error.credentialInUse: That account already exists — signing you into it.
error.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error.recentLoginRequired: Sign in again to confirm it is you.
error.providerDisabled: This sign-in method is switched off. Write to {{email}}.
error.unknown: Sign-in failed. Try again, and write to {{email}} if it keeps failing.

layout.title: Battle interface
layout.hint: One battle, three presentations. Switching is safe mid-fight.

console.name: Console
console.tag: Slot dock in firing order · permanent action console
console.desc: Cards in a grid, every control always in the same place.

orbit.name: Orbit
orbit.tag: Slot pods on an arc around your ship · radial die menu
orbit.desc: Your ship is on screen and takes the hits; actions open at the die.

tablet.name: Tablet
tablet.tag: Slot conveyor with live outputs · turn forecast
tablet.desc: Every number in one column, the whole turn priced before you end it.
